newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end mixed, blue chips mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end mixed, blue chips mostly lower.

text.p: Swiss shares ended Friday's trading session mixed with blue chips mostly lower in overall quiet dealings.
Dealers said softness in U.S. bonds earlier this week and subsequent interest rate worries weighed on Swiss financial shares, including banks and insurers.
But looking ahead, dealers said the SMI index could rise to 4,000 points if Wall Street remained stable in days to come.
At Friday's close the blue-chip Swiss Market Index was down 2.1 points at 3,940.1.
The December SMI futures contract closed down six at 3,944.
The broad Swiss Performance Index ended 0.16 points higher at 2,512.04.
Dealers said some dollar-earners and cyclical shares were in demand during Friday's session, the first of 1997, as activity resumed following New Year's.
Registered shares of Alusuisse rose 41 francs to 1,108.
Some traders said Alusuisse may have followed U.S. aluminium shares higher.
Gains in index pharmaceutical heavyweights Roche and Novartis helped to offset weakness elsewhere in the SMI index.
Roche gained 75 francs to 10,490 while Novartis shed just one franc to 1,532.
Swissair also rose strongly by 49 francs to 1,132.
